verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that different input configurations can be saved as separate tasks (apify-docs-17, apify-docs-25) and that a run can accept a startUrls list with a global maxCrawlPages limit (apify-docs-15). Separate tasks are separate runs, not per-URL-pattern settings within one batch job. Nothing documents applying distinct crawl settings to different URL patterns inside a single job, so the multi-task approach is only an adjacent workaround.

support.subject: As a developer, I can apply different crawl configurations to different URL patterns within a single batch job
